acceptance_profile.note: Structural accounting is not a Voice-profile result. No permitted reference pair, consent, rights-cleared cohort, exact runtime, transcript truth, identity measure, naturalness rating or timing exists, so every item is absent, unmeasured or structural only.

alignment_and_output_timing.requirement: Record alignment, first-output and tail timing for the exact runtime.

consent_reference_and_output_use.requirement: Treat consent, reference availability and output use as independent gates.

identity_similarity.requirement: Measure identity or similarity to the target as a separate outcome.

naturalness.requirement: Measure naturalness as a separate outcome.

permitted_source_and_target_references.requirement: Freeze permitted input and target references with rights and consent.

task_language_and_speaker_groups.requirement: Freeze task, language and speaker groups for the cohort.

text_and_semantic_preservation.requirement: Preserve text and semantic content as its own outcome.

stable_fields.acceptance: Apply the voice acceptance profile; record exact scope, evidence, failure/control results, and remaining release gates. A readiness conclusion with an exact external blocker is an accepted investigation handoff; it does not close the conditional implementation.
stable_fields.deliverable: Verify runnable source, exact assets, permitted scope, task geometry and matched evidence. Then reproduce the exact model/runtime as a caller-supplied-asset reference and add an opt-in SDK adapter once its prerequisites pass. Record a concrete blocker if feasibility fails.
stable_fields.title: Convert and Speak
write_scope: SDK provider, tool or evidence directory for convert-and-speak and its own fixtures

caller_asset_contract.notes: The manifest contract is structurally exercised, but every manifest is rejected because no immutable Convert and Speak revision, weight digest, runtime lock or rights record is approved. No file is loaded or executed and no audio is processed.

exact_blockers.requirement: Supply one exact Convert and Speak source tree or release archive with an immutable revision and matching SHA-256. No checkout, archive or adapter exists at any audited path.

Supply the exact conversion weights and any content-encoder, speaker-encoder or vocoder checkpoints with byte counts and SHA-256 values at an immutable revision. The merged research note records no runnable local checkpoint.
Provide a complete isolated runtime lock and recorded platform for the pinned source and weights. No data/envs/convert-and-speak environment or lock exists.
Stage the exact source and weight license terms, model card, attribution notices and derivative-output and redistribution review. The merged evidence records a paper/demo URL only.
Clear training-data, source-reference, target-reference, consent, output-use and corpus rights. The shared L2-ARCTIC sample clips are CC BY-NC 4.0 research-only and are not conversion pairs.

Freeze a rights-cleared held-out cohort with permitted source and target references, task/language/speaker groups, transcript truth and separate text/semantic, identity/similarity and naturalness outcomes. Only three shared demo clips exist.

Document the exact Convert and Speak input/output rate, channel layout, hop or chunk scheme, autoregressive lookahead, first-output and tail alignment for the pinned weights. None is published in the merged evidence.
Produce an approved exact-runtime Convert and Speak parity vector on frozen input with a frozen configuration, reproducible weights and byte-level or declared-tolerance output comparison.

qualification.reason: No Convert and Speak source, weights, runtime, approved revision, licence, consent record, rights-cleared voice cohort, geometry, parity vector or timing result exists. The merged note records only an inspected paper/demo.

release_gates.requirement: Exact pinned Convert and Speak source, weights and immutable revision with license identity, byte counts and SHA-256 values.
Isolated hash-pinned runtime admission, reproducible build and fail-closed absent behavior.
Code, weight, training-data, corpus, voice-reference, consent and output-use rights with attribution and notices.
Caller-supplied asset identity plus documented candidate geometry and content-delay mapping into the installed SDK v0 path.
Rights-cleared held-out voice cohort scoring text/semantic preservation, identity/similarity and naturalness separately.
Exact-runtime offline alignment, first-output and tail behavior, nonfinite handling, reset and state reproduction.
Target-device pacing, timing and memory with independent listening and/or ASR controls.
Opt-in provider intake, descriptor review, independent exact-head review and default/release approval.

reopen_condition: Pin the exact licensed Convert and Speak source, weights and runtime with an immutable revision, hash-pinned isolated runtime, cleared code/weight/training-data/corpus/consent rights, a rights-cleared held-out voice cohort, exact geometry and alignment, an approved parity vector, measured target timing and completed opt-in provider intake. Until then the candidate stays DEFER, incomplete and not qualified.
